name: 92408 · Sn Bernrdno, CA
findings: ZIP 92408 (Sn Bernrdno) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92408 (Sn Bernrdno) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92408 (Sn Bernrdno) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
